# Comptech Enterprises

Enterprise IT infrastructure and AI implementation partner based in New Delhi, India. Specializing in helping **MSMEs** and **Corporates** adopt, deploy, and scale AI across their daily business operations.

## AI Adoption Programs (MSMEs & Corporates)

### 1. MSME AI Adoption (Small & Medium Businesses)
- **Rapid AI Onboarding:** Cost-effective, plug-and-play AI agents for automated lead qualification, customer support, and sales outreach.
- **Workflow & Document Automation:** Automated invoice scanning, data extraction, accounting reconciliation, and repetitive back-office task elimination.
- **Practical Team Upskilling:** Hands-on workshops to train non-technical staff in everyday generative AI and prompt engineering to boost workplace productivity.

### 2. Corporate & Enterprise AI Integration
- **Private LLMs & Enterprise RAG:** Secure internal knowledge bases allowing staff to query enterprise documents without exposing sensitive data to public models.
- **Cross-Department Multi-Agent Systems:** Autonomous agent pipelines connecting CRM, ERP, and operational databases for end-to-end task execution.
- **Executive Strategy & Workforce Bootcamps:** Leadership advisory on AI governance, ROI measurement, and tailored role-based AI training programs.
- **AI Audits & Infrastructure:** Assessing AI readiness, data pipeline structuring, and deploying secure on-premise GPU clusters (NVIDIA & Intel powered).
